name: Venom Treble 3X Hooks
description: Chemically sharpened high-carbon steel treble hooks. Featuring 3X strong wire and an in-turned point design, these hooks are engineered to resist opening up under extreme pressure when fighting trophy fish.
features: Chemically sharpened points provide lightning-fast skin penetration
Nickel plating delivers 300 hours of saltwater resistance without rusting
Slightly in-turned hook points remain locked during massive headshakes

name: Octopus Pro Bait Hooks
description: Crafted with a offset beak-point and forged shaft. The Octopus Pro is the world standard bait hook for live or cut-bait presentations, providing maximum hold in the mouth corner.
features: Tapered up-eye allows easy snelling to heavy fluorocarbon lines
Forged shank flatting process increases wire bending threshold by 30%
Bright red finish stimulates feeding action in bottom reef structures

name: Circle Master Inline Hooks
description: Designed for catch-and-release conservationists. The Circle Master hooks are non-offset inline circle hooks. They slide to the corner of the fish's lip, completely eliminating gut-hooking risks.
features: Fully inline non-offset meets strict marine catch-and-release policies
Tin finish resists harsh ocean conditions for years of reusable storage
Extra wide gap accommodates large whole squid baits

name: J-Hook Classic Worm Hook
description: A classic offset shank round bend J-hook designed for rigging soft plastic worms. Excellent for Texas and Carolina rigging in dense freshwater weed beds.
features: 90-degree offset shoulder locks soft plastic heads in position without sliding
Round bend maximizes plastic clearance for a solid hookset
Highly affordable pack sizing for amateur bass anglers

name: Wide Gap Premium Swimbait Hook
description: An extra-wide gap (EWG) hook with a screw-lock bait keeper and integrated belly weight. Specifically crafted for weedless paddletail swimbait rigging.
features: Belly weight acts as a keel to keep swimbait running upright without rolling
Spring centering pin keeper holds soft plastics securely for multiple strikes
Super-wide gap clears thick-bodied swimbaits comfortably during hooksets
